summary: Read-only inspection of project-service/status/open APIs across packages/extensions project-service, apps/agent-server transport, packages/protocol projects/events/parsers, apps/app AgentClient/ProjectCapability/state, and the installed Unity gizmo registry. Mapped current contracts (single-owner ProjectStatus returned by one service, Unity-shaped UnityOpenProjectResult on the wire, per-session watch ownership in project-watch-coordinator, store-side selection in AgentStore/ProjectCapability) to prepare a recommendation for bounded structural removal.
